name: Namiel Hamsand
original_name: ナミール・ハムサンド
source:
The contestant in the Toushin Tournament, also applied herself as the partner.
A magic swordswoman who fights using "Magic Form" that can use unique magic, and "Sword Form" that has a skill completely comparable with a master swordsman.
Changing forms seems to change her personality also.

[Translate from [url=https://www.alicesoft.com/toushin3/chr11.html]official web[/url]]

[spoiler]Her real name is Lumiena Hamsand (ルミーナ・ハムサンド), [url=/c148078]real Namiel[/url]'s younger twin sister.[/spoiler]
